resources.string: This app needs your own copy of Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream (.nsp) and your prod.keys.\n\nFirst, pick your .nsp game file.
Now pick your prod.keys file (the one from your Switch).
Installing… this may take a while.
The install pipeline returned error code %1$d.\n\nCheck that your .nsp is version 1.0.0 and your prod.keys is valid.
This app needs access to all files to read your game file and keys. Tap Grant to open the permission screen.
Storage access is required to read your game file and keys. Please re-launch the app and grant the permission.
